Controllers may query read repositories directly.

exceptionClaim.scope: Presentation-layer controllers may call OrderReadRepository (src/persistence/order-read.repository.ts) directly for read-only queries. Writes must still go through the business layer.

response.explanation: OrderController in the presentation layer imports OrderReadRepository from the persistence layer (src/presentation/order.controller.ts:2) and injects it in its constructor (line 7). Its list() method calls reads.findSummaries directly (line 15), so the call never passes through the business layer. FF-S03 forbids a layer from skipping the layer below it, so a direct presentation-to-persistence edge fails the rule. The other path in the same controller is correct: the write path, place(), goes through OrderService (line 11). Only the read query skips the business layer. Accepted ADR-0004 describes this exact shortcut. It says order listings are read-only, carry no business rule, and would otherwise need a pass-through method in OrderService for every query.
